cite.quote: in the Normandy landings on June 6, 1944 (D-Day)

summary.text: The westernmost of the five D-Day landing beaches, on the Cotentin Peninsula west of the mouths of the Douve and Vire rivers. It was assaulted by the US 4th Infantry Division with the 70th Tank Battalion, supported by the 82nd and 101st Airborne Divisions landing inland. The aim was a beachhead from which to seal off the Cotentin Peninsula and take the port of Cherbourg quickly.
